Scripts/Player/Player.cs.description: Implementation of the procedural spine rotation in LateUpdate. It forces the assigned upper body bone to look at the aim position, overriding animation sway.

Scripts/Enemy/EnemyAI.cs.description: Prevents NavMesh error spam by completely disabling the AI component if the agent is not on a valid NavMesh at start. This provides a single, clear error message instead of a constant flood.
